Polish authorities say a fire at a WB Electronics drone-component facility was deliberate sabotage. 

The plant produces components for FlyEye and Warmate drones used by Poland and Ukraine.

“There is no doubt that it was deliberate arson, an act of sabotage.” — PM Donald Tusk

The rial has lost roughly 60% of its value since March.
